Build 3D games directly in your browser. Local-first. Visual authoring. Play, save, edit and export games without a traditional heavyweight engine install.

Open the Editor Play Example Games Explore Features

Best experienced on desktop or tablet with a keyboard/mouse.

Why Digital Opus Engine

Browser Native

Build directly in the browser -- no download, no install step to get started.

Local First

Projects and imported assets can stay in your browser/local workflow. No cloud account required to build a game.

Visual Authoring

Scene editor, Inspector, Behaviors, Node Graph, Sequences, and Prefabs -- build gameplay without writing engine code.

Standalone Export

Turn a project into a single self-contained playable HTML file, ready to share or host anywhere.

Real 3D Systems

Terrain, lighting, skeletal animation, AI, combat, camera paths and more -- already built in, not a roadmap promise.

About

Digital Opus Engine is an experimental, local-first browser game builder. These examples are real projects built with the same editor available above -- not a separate showcase team, and not the same thing as Digital Opus Games, our separate published games portfolio.
